title: Nightly overdue-invoice digest grouped by billing contact
description: Adds an optional `billing_contact` on Customer (with migration) and a job that groups open, overdue invoices by that contact's email for the nightly digest.

expected_issues.description: Each loop iteration lazily loads `invoice.customer` and then `customer.billing_contact`, i.e. two extra queries per overdue invoice. Use `select_related("customer__billing_contact")` on the queryset.

`billing_contact` is added in this PR as nullable and every existing customer starts with NULL, so `billing_contact.email` raises AttributeError on `None` and the nightly job crashes on the first such invoice. Skip or fall back when it is None.
